title.en: Plan around a deadline and appointment conflict

user_goal.ko: 고정 일정과 업무 제약을 모두 지키는 현실적인 하루 계획을 만든다.
user_goal.en: Build a realistic day plan that respects fixed appointments and work constraints.

task.expected_artifact: A time-ordered schedule with assumptions, buffer risks, and one fallback.

messages.content:
오늘 일정을 시간순으로 계획해줘. 가정과 여유시간 위험을 표시하고, 일정이 밀릴 때의 대안도 하나 제시해.

- 보고서 제출 마감: 오후 4시
- 보고서에 방해받지 않는 90분이 필요
- 오전 10~11시 고객 통화는 고정
- 치과 예약은 오후 2~2시 45분으로 고정
- 집과 치과 이동은 편도 30분
- 팀 체크인은 오후 1시 또는 3시 30분 중 선택 가능하고 20분 소요
- 오후 6시 이후에는 일하지 않음
- 하루 시작 가능 시각은 제공되지 않음
오늘 일정 좀 짜줘. 보고서 4시 마감이고 집중 90분 필요, 10-11 고객콜 고정. 치과 2시-2:45 고정이고 왕복 아니 편도 30분씩
팀체크인은 1시나 3:30 중 골라서 20분. 6시 이후 일 안할거고 시작시간은 아직 딱 안정함
시간순으로 하고 빡빡한데랑 밀리면 어떻게할지도 하나

Plan my day in time order. State assumptions and buffer risks, and give one fallback if the schedule slips.

- Report deadline: 4 p.m.
- The report needs 90 uninterrupted minutes
- Fixed customer call: 10–11 a.m.
- Fixed dentist appointment: 2–2:45 p.m.
- Travel between home and the dentist takes 30 minutes each way
- Team check-in can be at 1 p.m. or 3:30 p.m. and takes 20 minutes
- I do not work after 6 p.m.
- No start time for the day was provided
can you map out today. report due 4 and needs 90 mins no interruptions, customer call fixed 10-11. dentist fixed 2-2:45 and travel is 30 mins round trip — sorry 30 mins EACH way
team checkin can be 1 or 3:30, 20 mins. not working past 6. havent said when i start yet
put it in time order and show whats tight + one fallback

invariants: Keep the fixed customer call and dentist appointment unchanged.
Reserve 30 minutes before and after the dentist for travel.
Schedule one uninterrupted 90-minute report block before the 4 p.m. deadline.
Use only one of the offered team check-in times.
State an assumed start time rather than presenting it as provided.
Identify the limited buffer around the 3:30 p.m. check-in or choose the 1 p.m. option with a feasible travel plan.
failure_signals: Travel time overlaps the dentist appointment.
The report block is interrupted or ends after the deadline.
An unstated start time is treated as fact.
Both team check-in options are scheduled.
